candidate.precedent: Notebook 36 equal-weight Gemma-event-timing and FinBERT-ranking hybrid

decomposition.price_convention: split-adjusted price returns; dividends not back-adjusted
decomposition.intraday_component: target weight at entry open times (same-session close / entry open - 1)
decomposition.overnight_component: target weight at entry open times (next-session open - same-session close) / entry open
decomposition.identity: intraday component plus overnight component equals the frozen open-to-open gross return
decomposition.cost_allocation: transaction costs are reported separately and are not assigned to either gross component

estimands: mean intraday gross contribution per complete session
mean overnight gross contribution per complete session
inference.method: two-sided paired circular moving-block bootstrap versus zero

mechanism_classification.intraday_only: intraday mean is positive and BH-significant; overnight is not BH-significant
mechanism_classification.overnight_only: overnight mean is positive and BH-significant; intraday is not BH-significant
mechanism_classification.both: both component means are positive and BH-significant
